## NativeSelect.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The selected value. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new value whenever the selection changes.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the chevron; muted by default so the option labels carry the contrast.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. @default 'modern'
- `variant` :: `outline` is a bordered field, `secondary` a tinted one without a border, `ghost` is bare until hovered or focused. @default 'outline'
- `invalid` :: Marks the select invalid (red border, `aria-invalid`). Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `placeholder` :: A disabled first option shown when no value is selected, such as "Choose a region".
- `options` :: Options and optgroups to render. When omitted, pass `<option>` and `<optgroup>` as children.
- `ref` :: The underlying `<select>` element. Bindable, for focusing from code.
- `children` :: Custom `<option>` and `<optgroup>` elements, used when `options` is omitted.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the frame.

## options.ts

### `interface NativeSelectOption`

A single choice in a native select.

- `value` :: The value submitted with the form.
- `label` :: The visible label.
- `disabled` :: Prevents the option from being chosen.

### `interface NativeSelectGroup`

A labelled group of options, rendered as an `<optgroup>`.

- `label` :: The group's visible heading.
- `options` :: The options in the group.
